details.title: Preconditions

Step 1: If TH is aware of the DUT’s Discovery Capability Bitmask, it SHALL initiate Device Discovery in any order of priority on all the networking technologies that are supported by both the TH and the DUT If TH is unaware of the DUT’s Discovery Capability Bitmask, it MAY initiate Device Discovery in any order on all the networking technologies it supports out of Wi-Fi PAF, BLE, and on IP network discovery, or initiate Device Discovery on a specific networking technology.
Step 2: If (MCORE.DD.CHIP_DEV) then If !(MCORE.DD.CHIP_DEV) then If (MCORE.DD.DEV_LOCK) then If (MCORE.DD.DEV_BARRIER) then
Step 3: DUT begins sending ADVs. TH does not respond to these DUT ADVs so that the DUT can keep sending ADVs
Step 4: TH does not respond to DUT and DUT keeps sending ADVs
Step 5: TH does not respond to DUT and DUT keeps sending ADVs
Step 6: TH does not respond to DUT. User power cycles the DUT
Step 7a: TH waits until T0+ 2 minutes and 45 seconds and confirms that the DUT is still sending ADVs.
Step 7b: TH waits until T0+ 15 minutes and checks if the DUT is sending ADVs.
Step 8a: TH is configured to perform commissioning on Channel 6 in 2.4GHz band.
Step 8b: TH is configured to perform commissioning on Channel 44 in 5GHz band if it is in non-ETSI regulatory domains and on Channel 149 in 5GHz band if it is in ETSI regulatory domains.
Step 9: DUT begins sending Wi-Fi PAF Publish messages.

Step 12: TH and DUT are connected to the same network through vendor-unique means or by commissioning the DUT onto the Matter network and opening a commissioning window. The DUT is sending mandatory Commissionable Node Discovery service records over DNS-SD.
Step 13a: TH and DUT are connected to the same network and the DUT is sending optional Commissionable Node Discovery service records over DNS-SD.
Step 13b: TH and DUT are connected to the same network and the DUT is sending optional Commissionable Node Discovery service records over DNS-SD.
Step 13c: TH and DUT are connected to the same network and the DUT is sending optional Commissionable Node Discovery service records over DNS-SD.
Step 13d: TH and DUT are connected to the same network and the DUT is sending optional Commissionable Node Discovery service records over DNS-SD.
Step 13e: TH and DUT are connected to the same network and the DUT is sending optional Commissionable Node Discovery service records over DNS-SD.
Step 13f: TH and DUT are connected to the same network and the DUT is sending optional Commissionable Node Discovery service records over DNS-SD.
Step 14: Place the DUT device into a non-commissionable state
Step 15a: TH and DUT are connected to the same network and the DUT is sending a Commissionable Node Discovery service record over DNS-SD.

Step 15b: Mandatory Commissioning Subtypes: Send a browse request for '_services._dns-sd._udp' using a DNS-SD records command-line test tool (i.e. 'dns-sd -B _services._dns-sd._udp' or 'avahi-browse _services._dns-sd._udp -r')

Step 15c: Optional Commissioning Subtypes: Send a browse request for '_services._dns-sd._udp' using a DNS-SD records command-line test tool (i.e. 'dns-sd -B _services._dns-sd._udp' or 'avahi-browse _services._dns-sd._udp -r')
Step 16a: Place the DUT device into Commissioning mode
Step 16b: Send a browse request for '_matterc._udp' using a DNS-SD records command-line test tool (i.e. 'dns-sd -B _matterc._udp' or 'avahi-browse _matterc._udp -r')
Prompt Manual Log Upload

findings.evidence: Actual TXT contains D and CM0, no PH, in both complete normal/Memcheck and separate sanitizer runs. Builder defines exactly two TXT entries; host continues publishing in closed mode.
EXTENDED_DISCOVERY declaration absent in unchanged PICS while actual runtime advertises CM0. Optional TXT_KEY_PH branch also not enabled; this does not waive the mandatory PH requirement.
No distinct Extended Discovery timeout/disable control accepted on the reference CLI. Stopping the whole process is not treated as a verified customer privacy control.
